Label: Total
Definition: Total voting-age population, same as P3_001N

Label: minority
Definition: Minority voting-age population: depends on header information. It is inclusive (i.e. includes people identifying as two or more races)

Label: pctMinority
Definition: Minority composition of the census unit, calculated as minority / Total * 100

Label: frag_id
Definition: unique id, based on row number, for each fragment resulting from the intersection of census geometries with districts

Label: mpV
Definition: minority party votes (the party with fewer total votes in the state)
